Validation_Type.reason: Confirmed. Training uses ADNI-1/2/GO only, after an 8:2 subject-level split (p.3). Performance is reported on two test sets. Dataset B is the held-out 20% of ADNI-1/2/GO (101 subjects). Dataset A is 'an independent external test set' of 29 ADNI-3 + 144 OASIS-3 subjects (p.3). The headline comparisons are on Dataset A (Table 3, Fig. 7, and the Table 6 training-strategy ablation). The Platt-scaling calibrator is trained on the training set and only validated on Dataset A (p.9), so Dataset A never enters training. OASIS-3 is a separate study collected at a different institution, not a later ADNI phase, so Dataset A meets V4 ('a test set from a different institution'). The paper itself frames this as validation 'in cross-center scenarios' (p.2). Caveat: Dataset A results are pooled across ADNI-3 and OASIS-3, with no OASIS-only figure, but OASIS-3 makes up 144/173 (83%) of it. V2 ('no separate test set') is contradicted on any reading: even setting OASIS-3 aside, the held-out Dataset B makes the floor V3.
Validation_Type.quote: the model was trained and validated on the ADNI-1/2/Go datasets and tested on two independent datasets (ADNI-3 and OASIS-3).
Validation_Type.supporting_quote: Dataset A, as an independent external test set, consists of baseline T1-weighted sMRI images from 29 subjects in ADNI-3 and 144 subjects in OASIS-3.
